name: Scenic Drive RV Park
note: Gravel-loop RV park on Cheaha State Park Drive south of Anniston. Pull-through and back-in sites from $50/night, $250/week, $600/month (2026); booked online through Campspot. RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: scenicdrivervpark.com live with a 2026 rates page (pull-through/back-in from $50/night) and Campspot online booking; RV Life 4.5* $$ over 84 reviews (passes on the tier)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 33.6121,-85.7241: two gravel loops of RV sites in a wooded hollow beside the road; no water - not waterfront

name: Talladega Creekside Resort
note: Small campground beside Choccolocco Creek outside Talladega with RV sites, cabins and kayak/tube rentals and shuttles on the creek. Full RV sites (30/50 amp) $40/night plus tax (2026); race-weekend reservations carry their own cancellation terms. RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with an RV & camping rates page (full RV 30/50A $40/night + tax) and phone; RV Life 4.5* $$ over 42 reviews, Google 4.6 over 390
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 33.5264,-86.0391: office, cabins and an open lawn on the SW bank of Choccolocco Creek (~25-30 m wide); the RV sites cannot be told apart from the lawn under the trees and a fringe of bank trees lines the creek - defaulted down to not waterfront (creekside/riverfront candidate if a per-site map turns up)

name: Bama Campground & RV Park
note: Campground off Co Rd 3003 north of Double Springs with full-hookup RV sites (30/50 amp, water, sewer) on gravel pads 30x50 to 30x70 ft, plus tent sites from $25/night. RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: bamacampground.com live with a per-site RV page (gravel pads 30x50-30x70 ft, full hookups 30/50A) and phone; RV Life 5* $$ (passes on the tier), Google 4.5 over 87; RV nightly rate not shown on the scan (tent sites from $25)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 34.2221,-87.4202: gravel lot and buildings in open pasture with a small farm pond ~170 m south of the camping area across open field - not waterfront

name: Unhitched RV Cullman
note: Large RV park off Co Rd 1185 west of Cullman, part of the Unhitched chain. Standard sites from $45/night (2026), weekly rates lower; booked online through Newbook. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: unhitchedrv.com/cullman live with online booking (Standard site $45/night, Newbook engine); RV Life 4* $$ over 4 reviews, Google 4.6 over 841
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 300-500 m frames) at 34.2140,-86.9055: rows of pull-through sites in open grass north of a small pond; the one row near the pond is separated from it by a paved road and lawn - not waterfront

name: Logan Valley RV Park
note: Small RV park on Military St N in Hamilton with 30/50-amp, water and sewer hookups and Wi-Fi. Mostly long-term lots, but nightly stays are offered: $35/night, $210/week, $575/month. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: loganvalleyrvpark.com live with published rates (Nightly $35, Weekly $210, Monthly $575) and phone; RV Life 5* $$ (1 review), Google 4.7 over 19; long-term-leaning but nightly offered
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 1.4 km frame) at 34.1508,-87.9804: small gravel lot with RVs beside a building just east of US-43 in Hamilton (much of the frame under cloud); no water near the lot - not waterfront

name: Bama RV Station
note: RV park one mile off I-20/59 exit 76 in Cottondale, east of Tuscaloosa, with angled pull-through sites. Daily $50 for sewer sites, $45 without; weekly $200 (2026); booked online through Campspot. Long-term and football-season packages also sold. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: bamarvstation.com live with 2026 rates (daily $50 sewer / $45 non-sewer) and Campspot online booking; Google 4.5 over 156 (quality signal; RV Life lists it unrated as Greer Bros RV Park, Good Sam as A SKY Land RV Resort)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 33.1834,-87.4612: angled pull-through sites with grass islands behind light-industrial buildings off US-11; no water - not waterfront

name: Riverview Campground
note: Wooded campground on Lake Guntersville off Cha-La-Kee Rd (Cornwell Recreation). Most sites are let on 8-9 month seasonal contracts, but short-term camping for campers and RVs is offered at $35/night (7th night free, one-month maximum). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: campingguntersville.net live with a pricing page (short-term camping for campers and RVs $35/night, one-month max) and phone; Google 4.6 over 174 (quality signal; listed only in the Good Sam directory)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 34.3813,-86.3458: wooded campground on a Lake Guntersville point with sites under heavy canopy; the operator prices lake-front lots only as seasonal contracts and the short-term sites cannot be located - defaulted down to not waterfront
